The change makes `installed_capex` obtain weighting periods via `self._n.model.parameters.snapshots.to_index().unique(level="period")`, which assumes a MultiIndex with a named `period` level. For a multi-period model built with `optimization.model_snapshot_index="flat"`, snapshots instead have a flat tuple index, so this weighting lookup depends on the fixed MultiIndex representation rather than the selected representation and can fail.
